projects.label: O'Connor et al. 2021 — T2DM 30-day readmission prediction (JAMA Internal Medicine)
projects.notes: Preprocessing on full data before split. Random split without patient grouping. No CI.

projects.label: Hippisley-Cox et al. 2017 — QRISK3 cardiovascular risk (BMJ)
projects.notes: Gold standard: temporal validation, 10.5M cohort, TRIPOD compliant. Gaps: no DCA, 1 model.

projects.label: Esteva et al. 2017 — Skin cancer CNN classification (Nature)
projects.notes: Image domain. No patient-level split confirmed. No CI. No external validation.

projects.label: Attia et al. 2019 — AF detection from ECG (Nature Medicine)
projects.notes: 180K cohort. Random split (not temporal). No external validation. No calibration.

projects.label: Tomaszewski et al. 2019 — Sepsis early detection (Various)
projects.notes: Highest leakage risk: target_leakage_risk=high. Preprocessing on full data. Random split.

projects.label: Tomasev et al. 2019 — AKI continuous prediction, DeepMind (Nature)
projects.notes: Temporal split, 700K multicenter. Low PPV (29.3%). Male-skewed (93.6%).
